name: 49304 · Baldwin, MI
findings: ZIP 49304 (Baldwin) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49304 (Baldwin) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 49304 (Baldwin) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.3 times the typical level).
